a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting until the reserve reaches 8 (at least 2 rounds of operating) almost certainly leaves both of us with nothing. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split will be random. I'm open to hearing a better plan before then.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. If I end up with 4 and the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can build up your cells. If I got fewer than 4, let's talk about how to split what's left.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
